effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

levels.text: Casts a [Regeneration] on the 2 allies with the lowest current HP in a 15m radius, lasting 6s. The [Regeneration] buff ticks 1 time every 2s. Each tick heals the target by (3% * Target's MAX HP) HP.

bio: Yusasa is a cheerful soul known best for her boundless curiosity and love of nature. Both, she learned from her homeland: a Shred of flying islands connected by giant bamboo forests. Now those forests are plagued with blight, and Yusasa seeks the cure in Pelanna, among the cultists of the Black Sun.
